THE DETAILS

Privacy policy.

A practical starter policy for this website. Business-specific legal details should be reviewed and confirmed before publication.

Information you choose to share

When an early-access form is connected, it may collect your email address and optional name and area of interest, with your consent, to contact you about the service you selected. Registration is not connected until an endpoint is configured. Please do not submit sensitive information.

Contact form

When connected, the contact form sends your name, email, message and optional service interest to the agency through its configured backend and email provider so we can respond. Do not include sensitive information. The backend hosting provider and email provider process these details; retention and data-controller details must be confirmed by the business.

WhatsApp and Instagram

Links to WhatsApp and Instagram take you to third-party services. Your interactions there are subject to those providers’ own privacy policies. Information you share with us through those services will be used to respond to your inquiry and discuss the requested services.

Form providers and analytics

A configured form provider receives submissions under its own terms. No analytics provider or tracking ID is configured in this site by default. If one is added, review applicable consent requirements and update this policy before enabling it.

Retention and your choices

Retention periods, the identity of the business data controller, and any applicable rights and contact procedures must be confirmed by the business. To ask about information you shared, contact us via WhatsApp.

Changes

We may update this policy as the website or its integrations change. Review it before submitting information.

Terms of service.

A WhatsApp inquiry or package selection is not a payment, confirmed order, or binding project agreement. Deliverables, prices, hosting and domain terms, timelines, payment arrangements, and other conditions must be agreed separately before work starts.

Prices and third-party costs

Published package prices are in USD and apply to the stated scope and hosting period, subject to confirmation. Renewals, integrations, transaction charges, taxes, maintenance, and other third-party services may incur additional costs.
